name: e-w-framework-analysis-tool
description: The **E-W Framework Analysis Tool** is an open-source application designed to help education agencies, districts, and their partners evaluate their data readiness to answer key questions from the [Education-to-Workforce Indicator Framework (E-W Framework)](https://www.e-wframework.org/). It supports states and LEAs in identifying priority indicators, assessing gaps, and planning improvements in data infrastructure.
